status: assistant-development engineering protocol with scientific choices frozen before velocity payload inspection and a subsequent NPY-layout-only correction; not student preregistration

layout_amendment.reason: Both author-archive NPY headers omit the official format's size-one channel axis: (500,70,70) float32 C-order rather than (500,1,70,70). Header inspection followed the strict preparation failure; no model outcomes or velocity statistics were evaluated.
layout_amendment.unchanged: Same two source members, all 500 original models per family, selected indices/seeds, checkpoints, calibration bytes, geometry, physics, preprocessing, analysis and reporting choices

purpose: External generated-geology stress evaluation of two unchanged SubsurfaceGen-trained checkpoints and their existing calibration scales; report both checkpoints and all selected models without tuning or recalibration

archive.identity_scope: Version-specific author-provided archive; partial-member extraction cannot verify the full archive MD5

selection.duplicate_handling: Do not resample or discard selected duplicate models after inspection; record exact-hash groups and treat identical selected raw model hashes as one uncertainty unit
selection.observation_unit: one original generated velocity model; all derived source/frequency blocks share its model ID
selection.independence_scope: conditional generated-model stress units; no verified IID, independent real-site, or official benchmark split claim

evaluation_scope.wavefields: Regenerate synthetic reference Helmholtz fields; no original OpenFWI seismic records are used
evaluation_scope.calibrated_gate: Existing source-domain scales are frozen; all external/OOD conformal outcomes are descriptive with no exchangeability or coverage guarantee
evaluation_scope.required_reporting: Both checkpoints, both families, all selected original models and all four source/frequency blocks per model; preserve false acceptances and failed cases

analysis.direction: per-block negative neural gradient normalized by L2; zero direction if norm <= 1e-14
analysis.model_aggregation: all four source/frequency blocks per original generated model; families and checkpoints reported separately
analysis.uncertainty_scope: Model-level binomial/bootstrap intervals are conditional on an independent-generated-draw assumption; not independent real-site inference

attribution.archive: Li, B.; Wang, H.; Yang, X.; Lin, Y. (2022), Dataset - Solving Seismic Wave Equation on Variable Velocity Models with Fourier Neural Operator, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7272136
attribution.upstream: Deng et al., OpenFWI: Large-Scale Multi-Structural Benchmark Datasets for Seismic Full Waveform Inversion, NeurIPS 2022, arXiv:2111.02926
attribution.license_handling: Retain upstream noncommercial/sharealike restrictions and attribution for these source/derived data; separate from repository MIT code license. Archive metadata is not treated as overriding upstream terms.
